checks.name: divider PG_1V8_G [FET on at nominal rail]

checks.name: EN clamp turn-on (U4)
checks.detail: +VIN_SYS=20V -[R12=10000R]- EN, D5=MMSZ5231B zener->GND: EN at VIN=4.75V (5V contract low) must exceed enable+margin 1.5V (threshold 1.21V typ, SLVSDG6C) so the always-on buck is sure to start

checks.name: EN clamp ceiling (U4)
checks.detail: +VIN_SYS=20V -[R12=10000R]- EN, D5=MMSZ5231B zener->GND: EN at VIN=21.0V (20V+5%) worst-case (Vz 5.355V) must stay <= the EN recommended-max 5.5V (no internal clamp, I_hys 1.55uA only — SLVSDG6C)

checks.name: divider CP2102N_VBUS_SNS [abs-max at 5.25 V VBUS]
